order: Split execution into two tiers, mirroring the recon split between the scouting and investigating roles: keep the routine executor for well-scoped orders and add a heavy executor for hard-tier orders where capability provably cuts review rounds. Preserve the full executor law in the new brief and add its heavy-tier rules — read escalation case files first, surface cross-subsystem seams, bias toward the minimal coherent change, report dead ends at top tier. Document two-tier routing at PLAN, the single-use heavy escalation rung, and the REVISE escalation path, and add an abstention-over-plausibility rule to the investigating brief, where load-bearing recall is verified or downgraded and an evidence gap is never bridged without a citation. Sync the roster everywhere it is listed — the installer's copy list, the README, and the status skill's company check, which must report the core company complete or name what is missing.
claims: The heavy brief ships with the full executor law plus its tier rules, and the roster is synced across the installer, the README, the harness document and the status skill. A --check pass clears the installer and all 3 supporting scripts. An install round-trip into a temporary directory copies the agent set and finishes clean, and uninstall returns the project to a standard setup. The status company check, run against the installed tree, reports every core agent present with no findings line.
